propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when the remote ticket branch fetch fails or times out, instead of failing closed
the predicate functions _mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing check only local refs and fail to distinguish between a genuinely absent remote branch and an unreachable remote

a tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote with short-lived caching must be shared across all init paths to detect advertised (0), reachable-absent (2), and unreachable (timeout/other) states
unreachable remotes must fail closed with a diagnostic error and never create an orphan unless --force-new-store is explicitly supplied
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, return without error, and defer the actionable failure to the following strict init path via cached probe result

the --force-new-store CLI flag and force_new_store library parameter must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established, with warnings and normal behavior (not orphaning) when the remote is reachable
